title: NDRT 2020 full-scale flight — launch-through-apogee comparison
intended_use: Executed, non-calibrated comparison of Ascent's vertical engine against the measured NDRT 2020 flight, launch through measured apogee. Held below FlightValidated pending human review of the executed artifact.
source_authority: RocketPy RocketPaper NDRT_2020_launch_vehicle (MIT, © 2020 Projeto Jupiter), commit 23d9271db533f53eb91c778f67992c0ccbb0fd0f
input_pedigree: README.md — channel description and apogee row (343)
env_23.nc — ERA5 atmosphere (not consumable by Ascent; see mismatches)
uncertainty: barometric altitude channel, quantized to ~0.34 m steps
standard atmosphere substituted for the measured ERA5 sounding
launch aligned to recording start (no offset applied)

configuration_mapping.atmosphere: 1976 US Standard Atmosphere (source env_23.nc ERA5 sounding not consumed)

metrics.definition: |simulated − measured| apogee AGL / measured apogee AGL
RMSE of simulated−measured altitude over launch→apogee / measured apogee
|simulated burnout − imported motor burn time| / simulation timestep

caveats: Ascent performed no fitting or tuning against the measured flight.
Independence of the externally supplied NDRT parameters (especially Cd = 0.44) from the measured flight is not established; this is not a blind, independent, or preflight validation.
Comparison is ascent-only (launch→measured apogee); the overall result is derived from the three primary flight metrics, with burnout as an input-consistency check only.
Evidence held below FlightValidated pending review of the executed artifact.
known_mismatches: Ascent uses the 1976 US Standard Atmosphere; the source ERA5 sounding (env_23.nc) is not consumed.
Motor .eng burn time is 3.45 s (terminal-zero sample); the source input block lists 3.433 s. The imported curve is used verbatim.
Density-altitude offset from the 206 m launch elevation is not applied (standard atmosphere referenced to sea level).

known_limitations: Atmosphere: Ascent uses the 1976 US Standard Atmosphere; the source ERA5 sounding (env_23.nc) is not consumed.
Altitude channel is barometric AGL; density altitude offset from the 206 m launch elevation is not applied (standard atmosphere referenced to sea level).
Comparison window is launch→measured apogee only; descent, recovery, velocity, and acceleration are excluded from pass/fail.
